reports.name: specialty-eight-first
notes: Preplaced units (including a deliberately injured tank), completed buildings and a precharged paradrop are fixture setup, not AI production or an economic test.
Manual fixtures use no-op bots; AI fixtures run the actual Brutal CombatSquad through a Mission and ActionBatcher.
The engine handles every movement, shot and damage event. The AI context sees only GameApi-visible enemies.
Radiation can harm friendly units and has no engine player attribution; do not turn fixture success into match wins.
